verses.text: We’re writing about what existed from the beginning, what we’ve heard, what we’ve seen with our eyes, what we looked at, and what our hands touched—the Word of life.
This life was revealed, and we’ve seen it. We testify to it and announce to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
We announce what we’ve seen and heard to you too, so you can share fellowship with us. Our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
We’re writing these things so our joy may be complete.
Here’s the message we heard from him and announce to you: God is light, and there’s no darkness in him at all.
If we say we share fellowship with him while living in darkness, we’re lying and not living by the truth.
But if we live in the light, as he is in the light, we share fellowship with one another, and Jesus’ blood, his Son, cleanses us from every sin.
If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth isn’t in us.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
If we say we haven’t sinned, we make him out to be a liar, and his word isn’t in us.
My dear children, I’m writing these things so you won’t sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father: Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only ours but also the sins of the whole world.
Here’s how we know that we’ve come to know him: we keep his commands.
Anyone who says, “I know him,” but doesn’t keep his commands is a liar, and the truth isn’t in that person.
But if anyone obeys his word, God’s love is truly made complete in them. This is how we know we’re in him:
whoever claims to live in him must live as Jesus lived.
Dear friends, I’m not writing you a new command, but an old one you’ve had from the beginning. This old command is the message you heard.
Yet I’m writing you a new command, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing and the true light is already shining.
Anyone who says they’re in the light but hates a brother or sister is still in the darkness.
Anyone who loves their brother or sister lives in the light, and there’s nothing in them to make them stumble.
But anyone who hates a brother or sister is in the darkness, walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where they’re going, because the darkness has blinded them.
I’m writing to you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven through his name.
I’m writing to you, fathers, because you know the one who has existed from the beginning. I’m writing to you, young people, because you’ve conquered the evil one.

I’ve written to you, children, because you know the Father. I’ve written to you, fathers, because you know the one who has existed from the beginning. I’ve written to you, young people, because you’re strong, God’s word lives in you, and you’ve conquered the evil one.
Don’t love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in them.
Everything in the world—the cravings of sinful people, the lust of the eyes, and the pride in what they own and do—doesn’t come from the Father. It comes from the world.
The world and its cravings are passing away, but the one who does God’s will lives forever.
Dear children, this is the last hour. You’ve heard that the antichrist is coming, and many antichrists have already appeared. That’s how we know it’s the last hour.
They went out from us, but they didn’t really belong to us. If they had belonged to us, they would have stayed with us. Their leaving showed that none of them truly belonged to us.
But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
I’m not writing because you don’t know the truth, but because you do know it and because no lie comes from the truth.
Who is the liar? It’s whoever denies that Jesus is the Christ. That person is the antichrist, denying the Father and the Son.
Anyone who denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. Whoever acknowledges the Son has the Father too.
As for you, let what you heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you’ll remain in the Son and in the Father.
And this is what he promised us: eternal life.
I’m writing these things to you about those who are trying to lead you astray.

As for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need anyone to teach you. His anointing teaches you about everything, and it’s true, not a lie. So remain in him, just as it taught you.
And now, dear children, remain in him, so that when he appears, we can be confident and not shrink back in shame when he comes.
If you know that he is righteous, you also know that everyone who does what is right has been born from him.
See what great love the Father has given us, that we should be called God’s children—and that’s what we are! The world doesn’t know us because it didn’t know him.
Dear friends, we are God’s children now, and what we will be hasn’t been revealed yet. But we know that when Christ appears, we’ll be like him, because we’ll see him as he is.
Everyone who has this hope in him purifies themselves, just as he is pure.
Everyone who keeps sinning breaks the law; sin is lawlessness.
You know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and there’s no sin in him.
No one who remains in him keeps on sinning. Whoever keeps sinning hasn’t seen him or known him.
Dear children, don’t let anyone mislead you. Whoever does what is right is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.
Whoever keeps sinning belongs to the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The Son of God appeared for this reason: to destroy the devil’s works.
No one born of God keeps on sinning, because God’s seed remains in them. They can’t keep sinning, because they’ve been born of God.
This is how God’s children and the devil’s children are made clear: anyone who doesn’t do what is right doesn’t belong to God, and neither does anyone who doesn’t love their brother or sister.
This is the message you heard from the beginning: we should love one another.
Don’t be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. Why did Cain murder him? Because Cain’s actions were evil and his brother’s were righteous.
So don’t be surprised, brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.
We know that we’ve passed from death to life because we love our brothers and sisters. Anyone who doesn’t love remains in death.
Anyone who hates a brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in them.
This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us, and we should lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.
If someone has material things and sees a brother or sister in need but shuts their heart against them, how can God’s love remain in them?
Dear children, let’s not love with words or speech but with actions and truth.
This is how we know we belong to the truth, and how we set our hearts at rest in his presence:
whenever our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts and knows everything.
Dear friends, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have confidence before God
and receive from him whatever we ask, because we keep his commands and do what pleases him.
And this is his command: believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as he commanded us.
Whoever keeps God’s commands remains in him, and he in them. And this is how we know he remains in us: by the Spirit he gave us.
Dear friends, don’t believe every spirit. Test the spirits to see whether they’re from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
Here’s how you recognize God’s Spirit: every spirit that acknowledges Jesus Christ came in the flesh is from God,
and every spirit that doesn’t acknowledge Jesus isn’t from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you’ve heard is coming and is already in the world.
Dear children, you belong to God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.
They belong to the world, so they speak from the world’s viewpoint, and the world listens to them.
We belong to God, and whoever knows God listens to us; whoever doesn’t belong to God doesn’t listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
Dear friends, let’s love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
Whoever doesn’t love doesn’t know God, because God is love.
This is how God showed his love among us: he sent his one and only Son into the world so we could live through him.
This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
Dear friends, since God loved us like this, we should love one another too.
No one has ever seen God. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love is made complete in us.
This is how we know that we remain in him and he in us: he has given us his Spirit.
We’ve seen and testify that the Father sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.
If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in them, and they remain in God.
We’ve come to know and trust the love God has for us. God is love, and whoever remains in love remains in God, and God remains in them.
This is how love is made complete among us, so that we’ll have confidence on judgment day: in this world we are like Jesus.
There’s no fear in love. Complete love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. Whoever fears hasn’t been made complete in love.
We love because he loved us first.
Whoever claims to love God but hates a brother or sister is a liar. Anyone who doesn’t love their brother or sister, whom they’ve seen, can’t love God, whom they haven’t seen.
He has given us this command: whoever loves God must also love their brother and sister.
Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father loves his children too.
This is how we know we love God’s children: we love God and obey his commands.
Loving God means keeping his commands, and his commands aren’t a burden.
Everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
Who overcomes the world? Only the one who believes Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus Christ is the one who came through water and blood—not by water only, but by water and blood. The Spirit testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
There are three that testify:
the Spirit, the water, and the blood. These three agree.
We accept human testimony, but God’s testimony is greater, because it’s the testimony God has given about his Son.
Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony in their heart. Whoever doesn’t believe God has made him out to be a liar, because they haven’t believed the testimony God gave about his Son.
And this is the testimony: God gave us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
Whoever has the Son has life; whoever doesn’t have the Son of God doesn’t have life.
I’ve written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so you may know you have eternal life.
This is the confidence we have before him: if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
And if we know he hears us—whatever we ask—we know we have what we asked of him.

If you see a brother or sister commit a sin that doesn’t lead to death, pray, and God will give them life. I’m talking about those whose sin doesn’t lead to death. There is sin that leads to death; I’m not saying you should pray about that.
All wrongdoing is sin, and there is sin that doesn’t lead to death.
We know that everyone born of God doesn’t keep on sinning; the one born of God protects them, and the evil one can’t harm them.
We know that we belong to God, and the whole world lies under the evil one’s power.
We also know that the Son of God has come and given us understanding, so we may know the true God. We are in the true God by being in his Son, Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.
